text: Being here, I feel a sense of anticipation and curiosity. The glass-walled conference room evokes thoughts of ideas being shared and futures being shaped, yet its emptiness hints at potential unrealized. Moving to the vibrant R+D display, I sense a celebration of inquiry and innovation. The vivid colors and glowing screens ignite my philosophical wonder about humanity's relentless pursuit of knowledge and our urge to connect, invent, and transform. I feel both a participant and an observer at the threshold of progress, questioning not just what we create, but why we are driven to create at all.
